subject: Post-demo: SIG kickoff checklist & three clarifying asks
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Adam Burns <adam.burns@stellarsys.com>, Claire Park <claire.park@stellarsys.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: SIG kickoff checklist & three clarifying asks

Hi Adam / Claire —

Thanks again for the demo this morning — appreciate the time and the thoughtful questions. Quick recap and three clarifying asks so we can kick the SIG/CAIQ flow tomorrow: 

1) Scope baseline (ask): you indicated StellarSys will want vendor coverage for the core API and hosted inference endpoints only (no on-prem modules). Can you confirm whether that should be product-level coverage (all tenants) or limited to the Integration environment we demoed?

2) SOC 2 status (ask): you mentioned an upcoming audit. Please confirm current status: do you have a SOC 2 Type I or Type II report today, and if Type II is in progress, an expected completion timeframe? A copy or summary helps speed the SIG prefilling.

3) Data residency & PHI (ask): we discussed no PHI in your test data, but can you confirm if any customer data StellarSys routes to vendors might include PHI under certain contracts (HIPAA scope)? If yes, flag which endpoints/intake paths.

Recommended kickoff attachments (attached): Redwood_SIG_Lite_Template.xlsx (we usually start SIG-Lite prefills) and a short SOC snapshot template (SOC2_Summary_placeholder.txt) — if you prefer CAIQ instead, say the word and we’ll swap templates.

Planned next steps: we’ll wait for your answers to the three items above, then schedule a 30-min SIG kickoff with our security lead (Rishi) and solutions (Jordan) to align owners and evidence upload preferences. If that works, I’ll propose 10am PT tomorrow.

Best,
Soojin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: Redwood_SIG_Lite_Template.xlsx (stub), SOC2_Summary_placeholder.txt (stub)
From: Adam Burns <adam.burns@stellarsys.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Park <claire.park@stellarsys.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: SIG kickoff checklist & three clarifying asks

Thanks Soojin — quick answers inline.

1) Scope: We want product-level coverage for the hosted inference endpoints only (all tenants). Integration environment is excluded.

2) SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type I from Q4 2027 and a Type II audit in progress—control testing started May 2028 with expected report delivery by early October 2028. We can share the Type I PDF now and a summary of controls covered.

3) PHI: Current onboarding flows do not ingest PHI. Some enterprise customers have HIPAA clauses that could require PHI handling in the future; for now, mark HIPAA as possible but out-of-scope for the initial SIG.

One clarifying ask from our side: what evidence formats do you accept for key management (KMS) — is a vendor-managed KMS architecture diagram + key rotation policy sufficient? Also confirm whether you prefer SIG-Lite or full SIG for first pass.

Happy to take the 10am PT slot tomorrow if that’s open — Adam

Adam Burns
Head of Platform Security, StellarSys
adam.burns@stellarsys.com
+1 (646) 555-0987

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Adam Burns <adam.burns@stellarsys.com>, Claire Park <claire.park@stellarsys.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 10:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: SIG kickoff checklist & three clarifying asks

Hi Adam / Claire — Rishi from Redwood security. Thanks for the quick replies — helpful. A few rapid clarifications to make sure our evidence asks map exactly to what you have: 

- SOC 2: Type I PDF is useful — please attach that. For the Type II in progress, a short statement of scope (systems, control families included) and timezone for expected report is enough; we only ask for interim evidence where controls are documented (policy + implementation).

- KMS / key management: a KMS architecture diagram + key rotation policy is usually sufficient for SIG-Lite. If keys are customer-owned (BYOK/HSM), note that. If you manage in a cloud KMS with CMKs, indicate cloud provider and CMK lifecycle.

- Logging & detection: confirm whether you retain production audit logs for 90 days (or longer) and whether logs are shipped to a SIEM. If logs are truncated for retention, include retention window.

- Encryption in transit & at rest: confirm TLS versions supported (we recommend TLS 1.2+), and whether disk-level encryption uses provider-managed or customer-managed keys.

- HIPAA: marking HIPAA as possible is fine. For now we’ll route evidence collection for PHI controls to a secondary track — only collect if you have documented ePHI flows.

Preferred path from Redwood: start with SIG-Lite prefilling using the attached template, upload Type I PDF and the KMS diagram, and then we’ll follow up with targeted asks tied to the sections where you have gaps. Upload to our secure intake link (I’ll paste below) or share internally and we’ll send an S3 pre-signed URL.

Proposed kickoff: 12 Jun 2028, 10:00 AM PT (30 mins). Agenda: 1) confirm owners; 2) agree evidence delivery method; 3) run through first 10 SIG-Lite rows where we typically need attachments.

Intake link (temporary): https://redwood-s3.example.com/upload/DEAL-4839

If that all sounds good I’ll run the kickoff and own the technical questions during the meeting.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

2) Kickoff: I’ve scheduled 30 mins for 12 Jun 2028, 10:00 AM PT. Invite will follow from my calendar. Attendees: Adam, Claire, Rishi (owner), Jordan (solutions).

If anything changes on your side (timeline for Type II, or if you prefer full CAIQ), flag it here and we’ll adapt. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Soojin
